name: ch2_fig05_reaction_to_column

Override any general request for light colored fills: fill EVERY background, card, node, arrow, table cell, table header, and badge with the identical plain warm off-white #FCFCFA. Use color ONLY for crisp constant-width outline strokes and text. No colored interiors anywhere; no gradients, fades, highlights, glow, shadows, transparency, texture, lighting, tonal variation, or decorative grid. Title (top): "반응식에서 행렬의 한 열로" + smaller warm-grey "Reaction to matrix column". Use a strict two-block layout. LEFT block: show only the exact complete reaction as one large text line, "ATP + 포도당 → ADP + G6P + H⁺"; both plus signs on the product side and the reaction arrow must be present. Do NOT draw chemical structures, molecule icons, atom letters, bonds, rings, or a second shortened reaction line. This process arrow is not the chemical reaction arrow and must visibly connect the whole left block to the right table. RIGHT block: one clean vertical table headed "반응 R₁" with five aligned rows "ATP  −1", "포도당  −1", "ADP  +1", "G6P  +1", "H⁺  +1". Add exactly two small outline legend chips whose entire text is exactly "소비  음수" and "생성  양수"; do NOT prefix either chip with any extra minus or plus sign. VISIBLE TEXT MANIFEST: only the quoted strings in this prompt may appear, exactly spelled. No extra molecules, full-sentence explanation, caption, logo, watermark, gradient, or shadow.
